newsitem.title: USA: Xerox names Landman engineering systems CEO.
newsitem.headline: Xerox names Landman engineering systems CEO.

text.p: Xerox New Enterprises, the business development arm of Xerox Corp, said on Friday that Sidney Landman had been named as president and chief operating officer of Xerox Engineering Systems (XES), one of the Xerox New Enterprise Cos.
Landman succeeds former president Patricia Barron, who moved to a new position within the company, Xerox New Enterprises said.

Landman had been vice president of finance for Xerox Corp's Production Systems Group, and previously served as vice president of finance and business operations for Xerox Production Systems Division, the company said.
XES is a provider of solutions for engineering and technical document applications, including systems for wide-format printing, plotting, and copying, and for document management and distribution.
